sources.label: COTI Djed minting and burning FAQ

reserveReview.rationale: Current COTI and IOG materials identify ADA as DJED's exogenous reserve and SHEN as the reserve coin; the 400%-800% band governs mint and burn. Write-time re-open 2026-07-31: COTI's overcollateralization and minting FAQs still identify ADA-backed DJED and the 400%-800% reserve-ratio controls. Koios address_info at Cardano block 13,744,014 (2026-07-30T10:25:26Z) returned 28,551,265.718153 ADA at the reviewed Djed reserve script address, corroborating the single ADA reserve envelope. No public source provides a reconciled custody-account split or independent assurance report, so the envelope remains 100% ADA with liquidity horizon unknown.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: COTI Djed overcollateralization and minting/burning disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The reserve asset class and protocol reserve contract are identified and the current ADA balance is observable on-chain, but no independent reconciliation, reserve-account split, or operational custody detail is disclosed.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Reserves are ADA locked at a dedicated Cardano script address with no custodian; Koios address_info at block 13,744,014 (2026-07-30T10:25:26Z) returned 28,551,265.718153 ADA. COTI has not officially published the contract addresses — the inventory comes from the community-maintained open-djed registry — and the pre-launch audit COTI announced was never published with an auditor name or report. Legal bankruptcy-remoteness and rehypothecation terms do not apply to script custody; the reserve is delegated (staked) but not lent out.
